headline: U.S.-Iran fighting appears to pause. And, life inside Israel's military zones in Gaza
context: Fighting between the U.S. and Iran appears to have paused after two days of clashing amid a shaky ceasefire. And, a look at what life is like inside Israel's expanding zone of control in Gaza.

sources.name: NPR
